# Grace Ashdown

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c5 P1](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Agnes  <sub>[v5 c5 P0](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolgirl  <sub>[v5 c20 P0](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Pig-girl  <sub>[v5 c16 P23](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Grace has golden-brown ringlets. When she loses the bright color in her cheeks, she can appear pale, humble, and ordinary. Without full color in her cheeks, her appearance lacks its usual brilliance.

_Sources: [v5 c16 P17](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0017), [v5 c16 P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029)_

## Personality

Grace is high-spirited, courageous, and determined, rarely backing down from a task once she sets her mind to it. She enjoys life immensely and prefers taking active steps to assist others over running away from suffering. Though bold and persistent, insults easily wound her pride and spirit far more than physical pain.

_Sources: [v5 c16 P17](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0017), [v5 c16 P19](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0019), [v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c16 P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029)_

## Traits

- Spirited and determined  <sub>[v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c16 P29](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0029)</sub>
- Dislikes watching others suffer  <sub>[v5 c16 P17](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0017)</sub>
- Sensitive to insults  <sub>[v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026)</sub>

## Abilities

- Hornpipe dancing  <sub>[v5 c5 P0](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To assist others when they are in distress  <sub>[v5 c16 P17](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0017)</sub>
- To secure church contributions to prevent her father from having to leave the Glen  <sub>[v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c16 P39](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0039)</sub>

## History

Grace spent a Saturday morning exploring with her siblings, Tobias, Ida, and Rupert. In Mr. Taylor's old barn, they discovered Mary Stubbs hiding in the hayloft and starving. Distressed by Mary's plight, Grace immediately embraced her and ordered Tobias to stop troubling the girl. Following a widely spread story about her rooster Adam, Grace was mocked by her peers at school. Seeking comfort, she went to Fern Hollow to visit Mrs. Carrow. Learning Mrs. Carrow was away, Grace encountered Clementine Ainslie. Encouraged by Miss Ainslie's sincere demeanor, Grace confided the whole story of Adam's fate to her. Concerned that her father might be forced to leave the Glen due to unpaid church wages, Grace took it upon herself to visit Lionel Fairlie. En route, she was accompanied by Edmund Carrow until they encountered Dan Coyle, who insulted her by calling her a pig-girl.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P4](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0004), [v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 c5 P17](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0017), [v5 c5 P19](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0019), [v5 c5 P20](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0020), [v5 c16 P19](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0019), [v5 c16 P23](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0023), [v5 c16 P26](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0026), [v5 c16 P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 c16 P39](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0039), [v5 c20 P0](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0000), [v5 c20 P1](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0001), [v5 c20 P3](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0003), [v5 c20 P9](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0009), [v5 c20 P17](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0017)_

> You cease troubling her.  <sub>[v5 c5 P20](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0020)</sub>

> My purpose in coming—was to request that you—attend church—and contribute—toward the wage.  <sub>[v5 c16 P39](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0039)</sub>
